LEASE ABSTRACT

Landlord: Cascade Properties LP ("Landlord")
Tenant: Northgate Analytics, LLC ("Tenant")
Premises: Suite 400, located at 2200 Harbor View Boulevard ("the Premises")

Article 1 - Premises and Rentable Area
The Premises consist of 18,400 rentable square feet and 15,600 usable square feet, reflecting a load factor of 1.18.

Article 2 - Base Rent
Base Rent for the Premises during the initial Lease Year shall be $34.50 per square foot per year, payable in equal monthly installments.

Article 3 - Rent Escalation
Base Rent shall increase by 3.00% per annum on each anniversary of the Commencement Date throughout the initial Term.

Article 4 - Operating Expense Stop
Landlord shall be responsible for Operating Expenses up to a stop of $12.75 per square foot per year, with Tenant responsible for its pro rata share of Operating Expenses in excess of the stop.

Article 5 - Tenant Improvement Allowance
Landlord shall provide Tenant a tenant improvement allowance of $45.00 per square foot toward the cost of Tenant's initial build-out of the Premises.

Article 6 - Security Deposit
Tenant shall deposit with Landlord a security deposit of $99,875.00 upon execution of this Lease, held as security for Tenant's performance under this Lease.

Article 7 - Term
The initial Term of this Lease shall be 84 months, commencing on the Commencement Date.

Article 8 - Renewal Option
Tenant shall have one option to renew the Term for an additional period of 60 months, provided Tenant delivers written notice of its election to renew not less than 270 days prior to the expiration of the initial Term.

Article 9 - Renewal Rent
If Tenant exercises the Renewal Option, Base Rent during the renewal term shall be adjusted to $38.00 per square foot per year, subject to further annual escalation of 3.00%.

Article 10 - Parking
Tenant shall be entitled to 46 unreserved parking spaces in the Building's parking structure at no additional charge during the initial Term.

Article 11 - Late Charges
Any Base Rent payment not received within 5 days of its due date shall be subject to a late charge equal to 5.00% of the overdue amount.

Article 12 - Assignment and Subletting
Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet the Premises without Landlord's prior written consent, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld.

Article 13 - Right of First Refusal
Tenant shall have a right of first refusal on the adjacent Suite 410, comprising 6,200 rentable square feet, should it become available for lease during the initial Term.
